manifest.author: kody-w
manifest.description: Deploys Copilot Studio agents into Dataverse four ways: REST ImportSolutionAsync, the pac CLI pipeline, the quality-gated FACTORY chain, or the NEW-experience MCP shape (BlastBox two-solution: inline-MCP connector + new-generation connected agents, channel-less parents, publish-verified).
manifest.name: @kody-w/copilot_studio_deploy_agent

confirm.description: Required true for the DESTRUCTIVE import/deploy step.

engine.description: rest = REST ImportSolutionAsync (service principal); pac = pac-CLI end-to-end pipeline; factory = quality-gated agent.py -> RAPP pipeline chain (SYNTHETIC_DATA seeds, connector hygiene, verified deploy; modes check/scaffold); mcp = NEW Copilot Studio experience (BlastBox two-solution MCP shape: inline-MCP connector + new-generation cliagent parent/connected child, channel-less, publish-verified). actions generate|deploy|verify.

environment.description: pac engine: target Dataverse environment URL.

forge_dir.description: rest engine: directory of forge output YAMLs to package.

input_path.description: pac engine: brainstem agents/ dir or blueprint.

output_dir.description: Where to write packaged solution artifacts.

package_zip.description: rest engine: path to a prebuilt .solution.zip.
